title: Getting started with your treatment
body: Once your provider approves you and your first prescription is filled, your medication ships to the address on your account. Shipments go out from our pharmacy partner in Oshkosh, Wisconsin and typically arrive within 3-6 business days.
When your package arrives, let us know in the app or by replying to your text message. That confirmation is what lets us set up your treatment schedule.
You then choose your start date. Your treatment begins that evening, and you'll get a text each day with your dose and a short check-in.
Your first weeks are about finding the dose that works for you. Most people start at a quarter of their troche strength and adjust gradually based on what you report in your check-ins.
